    <div>
      <h1>Context Budget Allocation Worksheet</h1>
      <p class="ws-sub">A per-repository context budget with a hard eager-load ceiling and a named treatment for every category &mdash; the number a team can regression-test against.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="ws-meta">
      <b>WS-15-context-budget-allocation</b><br>

    <code>handbook/ch15-attention-and-context-economy.qmd</code> L102-120 &middot;
    <a href="https://danielmeppiel.github.io/agentic-sdlc-handbook/handbook/ch15-attention-and-context-economy.html#sec-attention-budget">#sec-attention-budget</a>
    &middot; prerequisite: <b>WS-21-primitive-governance-policy</b>
  </div>

  <div class="ws-instruction">
    One repository, two people, the harness's verbose log open beside this sheet. For each of the eleven categories, tick or untick column 2 (untick, never delete), then fill columns 6&ndash;12 and 14 in your own words and numbers. Fill column 7 from the harness token report, not from recollection. The shaded italic columns 3&ndash;5 are the book's calibration, not yours. Column 13 ticks itself from your column 10 choice. Totals and the committed ceiling are on sheet 4.

<!-- ============================ SHEET 3 ============================== -->
<div class="sheet">

  <div class="ws-head">
    <div>
      <h1>Context Budget Allocation Worksheet</h1>
      <p class="ws-sub">Footer block &mdash; the number the sheet exists to produce: the committed eager-load ceiling.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="ws-meta">
      <b>WS-15-context-budget-allocation</b><br>
      Pack Z - Second wave: the practitioner kit<br>
      fill order <b>9</b> &middot; type <b>calculator</b><br>
      audience <b>practitioner</b>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="ws-block">
    <h2>Footer block
      <span class="ws-block-note">one per repository; the committed ceiling is the only limit on this sheet, and your team writes it</span></h2>

    <table class="ws">
      <colgroup>
        <col style="width:4%"><col style="width:30%"><col style="width:36%"><col style="width:30%">
      </colgroup>
      <thead>
        <tr><th></th><th>Footer field</th><th>Notes</th><th>Your answer</th></tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">1</span></td>
          <td><b>Model and harness this budget is written against</b></td>
          <td class="prior">Numbers will shift with model, harness, and task.<span class="prior-src">ch15 L102</span><br><span style="font-style:normal">Name both explicitly: a budget with no named model is not a budget.</span></td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-text"></span></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">2</span></td>
          <td><b>Window size for that model</b></td>
          <td class="prior">—</td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-text"></span></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">3</span></td>
          <td><b>Eager-load subtotal</b></td>
          <td class="prior">—</td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-computed" data-formula="sum of column 7 where column 13 is ticked"></span></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">4</span></td>
          <td><b>Share of window consumed before any source file is loaded</b></td>
          <td class="prior">—</td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-computed" data-formula="eager-load subtotal (field 3) &divide; window (field 2)"></span></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">5</span></td>
          <td><b>Committed eager-load ceiling</b></td>
          <td class="prior">—</td>
          <td class="fill tall"><span class="f-text sm"></span><span style="font-size:7.4pt;color:#454f59">Your team's own number, written down and regression-tested. The durable output of this sheet. The book supplies no value.</span></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">6</span></td>
          <td><b>Ceiling owner</b></td>
          <td class="prior">—</td>
          <td class="fill"><span class="f-owner"></span></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">7</span></td>
          <td><b>Date written / next review</b></td>
          <td class="prior">—</td>
          <td class="fill">
            written <div class="f-date"><span class="seg d"></span>/<span class="seg m"></span>/<span class="seg y"></span></div>
            next review <div class="f-date"><span class="seg d"></span>/<span class="seg m"></span>/<span class="seg y"></span></div>
          </td>
        </tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
  </div>

  <div class="ws-block">
    <h2>Two heuristics
      <span class="ws-block-note">the test to apply when column 10 and column 5 disagree</span></h2>
    <div class="prior" style="margin-bottom:2mm"><i>Anything that is needed on every turn earns a place at the head; everything else should be progressive.</i><span class="prior-src">ch15 L118</span></div>
    <div class="prior"><i>Anything that grows without bound across a session is a candidate for a periodic reset and a one-paragraph summary.</i><span class="prior-src">ch15 L118</span></div>
  </div>

  <div class="ws-foot-quote">
    "The table below is not a benchmark; it is a starting calibration." (ch15 L102)
  </div>

  <div class="ws-foot">
    <div>WS-15-context-budget-allocation &middot; The Agentic SDLC Handbook worksheet kit &middot; sheet 4 of 4</div>

</div>
